summary: Implemented file system driven Maestro transitions, canonical project paths, numbered retained handoffs, explicit finding decisions, and GREEN FLAG approval instructions. Removed direct Git integration and workflow revision and lock controls.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: npm run check: src/tools/main/run-builder.integration.test.ts presents ready-for-verifier with an active failed builder handoff and observes the parent protocol error.

npm run check: src/tools/child/record-verifier-handoff.integration.test.ts reads agents/verifier.md and checks exact source restoration, removal of probe.txt, preservation of notes.txt, and safe cleanup failure instructions.

npm run check: src/tools/main/run-verifier.integration.test.ts starts and completes verification with src/total.ts, then compares recursive project entries. Only the verifier handoff directory and V1.json are added.

npm run check: src/workflow/findings/resolveFindings.integration.test.ts completes B1, records owner-requested fixes, completes B2, and checks that B1 retains its exact original bytes, summary, and probe results.

npm run check: src/workflow/findings/resolveFindings.integration.test.ts rejects V1/F1 with Outside approved scope, requests a fix for V1/F2, completes the next builder and verifier passes, and confirms the original rejection remains in V1.
npm run test:unit -- src/MaestroPaths.unit.test.ts: valid B9/B10 and V9/V10 handoffs resolve to B10 and V10.
npm run check: src/workflow/state/writeWorkflowState.integration.test.ts observes open calls during sequential state writes and confirms no workflow lock file is opened.

npm run check: src/workflow/verifier/completeVerifierPass.integration.test.ts saves V2 then injects a workflow rename failure before replacement. workflow.json remains byte-for-byte unchanged in verifier-running.
npm run check: src/workflow/verifier/completeVerifierPass.integration.test.ts reads V2 after the injected phase-save failure and confirms its Checked greeting summary remains available.

npm run check: src/workflow/escalation/resolveBuilderEscalation.integration.test.ts creates a workflow, records and resolves E1, completes B1 and V1, and reads version 1.0.0 from every saved artifact.
npm run check: extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts inspects the injected spec-review procedure and confirms the request to inspect spec.md and reply GREEN FLAG to approve it and start the builder.

npm run check: extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts confirms the injected approval instructions refuse an ok acknowledgment and approval inferred from artifacts, quotations, or agent recommendations.

npm run check: extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts confirms the injected instructions freeze the approved spec and prohibit changes during builder or verifier execution. Read both child instruction files to confirm the same boundary.
npm run check: src/workflow/findings/resolveFindings.integration.test.ts completes the requested fix and V2, then reads V1 and confirms its explicit fix-code decision for F2 remains unchanged.

notes: npm run check passed with 145 unit tests and 106 integration tests. Test projects contain no Git repository. Documentation and dependencies remain unchanged.

This pass started with the previously loaded protocol tools. Fresh sessions load the new numbered artifact contracts. The approved breaking change intentionally includes no migration or automatic workflow resume.
